answer: Resist Sybils with a slashable performance bond: to register, an agent locks stake that is forfeited if its attestations prove false, so an attacker who tries to forge a thousand identities must fund a thousand bonds — the cost scales linearly with the attack while honest agents pay once. Reputation then accrues slowly from verified work, so a fresh identity sits at its nadir with no voting weight, and only sustained honest service earns the jade-grade standing that unlocks full participation.
